title: Homogenization of regularized Oldroyd-type fluids
summary: We study homogenization of a regularized viscoelastic Oldroyd-type model in a periodically perforated bounded domain. The system describes an incompressible non-Newtonian fluid coupled to an elastic extra stress tensor and includes both nonlinear viscosity and nonlinear stress diffusion effects. The governing model, introduced by Kreml, Pokorný, and Šalom (2015), covers Oldroyd-A- and Oldroyd-B-type constitutive laws. We establish qualitative and quantitative homogenization results in suitable scaling regimes and show convergence toward an effective Darcy law on the macroscopic domain. In…
